summary: Quiet street where cars park, but apartment blocks sit 11-16 m from the kerb.
reasons: Bus zone sign near the start

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks line the north side 11-16 m from the kerb; houses beyond 23 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel parking on the street with cars already parked; room to stop clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along both kerbs, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Bus zone sign near 0 m; keep clear of it
Low-lying: about 4.6 m elevation, no mapped waterway
sun_shade: Street trees shade part of the north kerb; the apartments to the north block some morning and midday sun.

best_section.where: Mid-block on the north kerb, between the two apartment driveways, east of the bus zone
